note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #27, Q3 2024 Conflicts) keeps INEGI columns bp2_1..bp2_4_11 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0924.csv (imported lowercased) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); the bookmark is identical to Q2's #23 apart from the input file. mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's own Q3 data dictionary labels each BP2_* column (e.g. BP2_2_16 'Conflictos o enfrentamientos: Grafiti o pintas a su casa por alguien que usted identifique'; BP2_3_4 'Incidentes o problemas con desconocidos(as) en la calle'; BP2_4_09 'Tipo de consecuencias derivadas de conflictos: Dialogo o platica'); 37/37 labels agree in content with the Q3 questionnaire option carrying the same code number. Q3 vs Q2 source check (done, not assumed): (a) the CP2 read-aloud introduction was REWORDED in Q3 -- Q2 'En su vida cotidiana usted puede ser victima de situaciones conflictivas con familiares, vecinos(as), ... A continuacion...' became Q3 'Las situaciones conflictivas pueden ser parte de nuestra vida cotidiana. A continuacion, le hare algunas preguntas relacionadas con este tipo de situaciones.' -- so instructions/instructions_translated differ from batch_676; (b) the 2.2 stem's Q2 typo 'familares' is corrected to 'familiares' in the Q3 print, so no sic remains; (c) everything else in Section II (2.1 stem, 2.3/2.4 stems, all 18+7+11 options, codes, skip instructions) is identical to Q2. Q3 dictionary has the same 37 BP2_* variables as Q2 with identical labels except BP2_2_06, whose label now ends 'etcetera)' where Q2's ended 'etc.)' (the printed option reads 'etcetera)' in both); all 37 bp2_* catalogos are byte-identical to Q2's. Every one of the 38 distinct Spanish strings shipped (CP2 intro, 2.1 stem, 2.2/2.3/2.4 stems, 18+7+11 options) is found in the Q3 PDF's text layer after whitespace normalisation (two-column layout needed pdftotext non-layout/raw order; '...producto/ servicio...' line wrap joined), and 110-dpi renders of pp.3-4 were read to confirm. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 37 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI Q3 2024 CSV after the .do's recodes, 74/74 item x level counts (e.g. bp2_1 1/2 = 9720/14366, bp2_2_16 0/1 = 9193/527, bp2_2_18 0/1 = 8160/1560, bp2_4_09 0/1 = 3609/4551); raw has 24096 rows, 10 bp2_1=9 set missing by the .do -> 24086 live ids (those 10 are also blank on every later bp2 item); 6 respondents' bp2_3_*=9 set missing on all 7 bp2_3 items. Words: item_text / section_prompt / instructions are the administered questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials), not the terser dictionary labels. Kept as printed: '(as)' gender fills, trailing '?' on 2.2 options and the stem's trailing ellipsis. Normalised: line wraps joined with a space. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blanks after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'B' Y CIRCULE UN SOLO CODIGO / LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; PASE A LA SECCION III; SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 18 'NINGUNO', PASE A LA SECCION III). Structure (same as batch_672/676): section _1 = 2.1 screener (stem in item_text), _2 = 2.2 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _3 = 2.3, _4 = 2.4; instructions = CP2 read-aloud introduction. Options: bp2_1 1=Si, 2=No (questionnaire and catalogo; 9 'No sabe / no responde' set missing by the .do, no row). The 36 checklist items are 0/1 flags; option_text is INEGI's catalogo value label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si', identical in all 36), not questionnaire print. Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Routing (not a defect): 2.2 asked only if 2.1=Si (n=9720 = bp2_1 Si count); 2.3/2.4 skipped when 2.2 code 18 'Ninguno' was circled (8160 = 9720 - 1560; bp2_3 n=8154 after the 6 code-9 respondents). Step 3b: live items match this question block exactly (37 = 1 + 18 + 7 + 11); dictionary Description ('Q3 2024') is accurate, but the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2024 Q3 (septiembre 2024, file suffix 0924) wave -- same defect as the Q1/Q2 siblings. Minor INEGI-side oddity, no effect here: the Q3 dictionary's PER range reads '0324' (Q2's read '0224'). English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation): reused verbatim from batch_676 wherever the Spanish is identical (2.1 stem, 2.2/2.3/2.4 stems and all options, incl. batch_676's 'family members' for the 2.2 stem, which already read through the typo); the reworded CP2 introduction was translated fresh for this table. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, tercer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section II (questions 2.1-2.4) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
